verdict.rationale: Slack ships AI features (Slackbot, summaries, AI huddle notes), so whether customer data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a training opt-out, data-use policy or similar control. Admin approval of MCP client integrations is an adjacent access control, not a training opt-out, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
